The long game: picnic at Big Tree Park

  • Sat, Feb 20 · 10 am to 12 pm
  • Big Tree Park, Longwood · Free

Are you in?

I'm in
TDC+2629 going (DEMO)

Part of January’s lineup, which drops Tue, Dec 15 at noon (DEMO). You can save a seat now.

This one already happened. Here’s what’s next.

Snacks, sticker design and some very old trees. A good place to plan 2027.

What's the plan

Big Tree Park is where The Senator, a bald cypress about 3,500 years old, stood until it burned in 2012. A clone called The Phoenix grows there now, and Lady Liberty, about 2,000 years old, still stands nearby. It's a good place to talk about the long game. Bring a blanket. We'll bring snacks, markers and blank sticker sheets so you can design a sticker for our 2027 season, and members vote on the winner (DEMO).

Getting in

Short walk from parking. Need a chair? Tell us when you RSVP and we'll bring one.

First time? Here's what happens

  1. Tap I’m in. A first name and one way to reach you, that’s it. No account.

  2. The day before, you get one reminder with the details.

  3. Show up, look for the celery-green sign (DEMO), and someone will say hi and introduce you around.

Where the facts on this page come from

  • The Senator, an approximately 3,500-year-old bald cypress in Longwood's Big Tree Park, was lost to fire in January 2012. A clone of The Senator named The Phoenix was planted near the park's playground.

    Source: seminolecountyfl.gov · Source: en.wikipedia.org

  • The fire was reported on Jan 16, 2012, and Big Tree Park reopened on Mar 2, 2014 after almost a year closed for renovation.

    Source: en.wikipedia.org

  • Lady Liberty, The Senator's sister tree, is an approximately 2,000-year-old bald cypress that still stands in Big Tree Park.

    Source: seminolecountyfl.gov · Source: en.wikipedia.org

  • Big Tree Park is at 761 General Hutchison Parkway, Longwood (Seminole County parks page).

    Source: seminolecountyfl.gov

Links checked Nov 9, 2026.

The fine print

We ask before we post anyone's photo, and a parent or guardian says yes first for anyone under 18. Rather not be in pictures? Tell us at check-in.

We never collect forms, signatures or personal information at events. You do everything yourself on official sites.

Be kind, let people finish their sentences, and look out for each other. Anyone who harasses someone is asked to leave.
